subject: Evergreen onboarding — PO number missing & spend cap blockage
body:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@evergreensys.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Evergreen onboarding: missing PO & spend cap block

Hi David / Monica,

We're trying to finish the vendor onboarding for Evergreen Systems but the portal is rejecting our merchant activation because a PO number wasn't assigned and the spend cap is set to $0 for our account. Procurement here needs a formal PO to proceed with billing and the integration team is blocked from scheduling the first sync.

I've attached the completed onboarding form (Evergreen_onboarding_form.pdf) and included the high-level line items below. Can Redwood issue a provisional PO or tell us the expected timeline for a permanent PO? We need something before the end of week to keep the go-live date.

Vendor: Evergreen Systems
Merchant ID: EVG-7782 (internal)
Requested spend cap: $75,000 monthly
Primary items (approx):
- Core inference calls (est. 2M tokens/mo)
- Dedicated monthly support credit
- Onboarding professional services (one-time)

Thanks — let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Sara Lin
Procurement Coordinator
Evergreen Systems
attachments: Evergreen_onboarding_form.pdf

---

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@evergreensys.com>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:03:01 -0700
Subject: Re: Evergreen onboarding: missing PO & spend cap block

Hi Sara — thanks for the form and the background. Copying the procurement team to expedite.

Quick notes:
- I'm seeing the intake flagged because the onboarding flow couldn't resolve a purchase-reference mapping (the PO issuance queue had a short backlog yesterday). That looks like a queue jam rather than missing data.
- We can provisionally assign a temporary PO (PO_2026-00078) to unblock activation while procurement confirms the final numbering. That will allow billing and the account to be created.

Action items for us:
1) Monica — can you review the requested spend cap and confirm whether finance can approve a provisional $75k monthly cap for Evergreen (or propose a smaller pilot cap)?
2) Marcus — can you confirm the SKU/line-item mapping once Evergreen sends the CSV? We should also flag any items that need to be split across billing buckets.
3) Priyom — if procurement approves provisional PO issuance, please publish a stub and escalate a permanent PO assignment to Finance Ops.

Sara — two small asks from your side: please send the line-item CSV and indicate whether professional services should be on a separate invoice line.

I'll stand by for the CSV and will hold off on scheduling any database changes until Marcus confirms mapping.

Thanks,
David Kim
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

---

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:21:49 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evergreen onboarding: missing PO & spend cap block

Thanks David. Finance is willing to greenlight a provisional spend cap for pilot customers, but we need a one-page SOW or an estimate for initial usage to justify $75k. If Evergreen can accept a staged cap (e.g., $25k for month one, auto-up to $50k after usage review) that will speed approval.

I'll draft a note to Finance Ops and attach the onboarding form. Priyom — pls loop legal if we need a PO term amendment.

Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: onboarding_form_excerpt.pdf

---

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@evergreensys.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, procurement@evergreensys.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:44:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evergreen onboarding: missing PO & spend cap block

Hi David / team,

Thanks — attached is the requested CSV (evergreen_lineitems.csv). Professional services should be billed as a separate line. The CSV includes line descriptions and recommended GL codes.

If a staged cap helps, Evergreen can accept $25k for the first 30 days with a review at day 21 to bump to $50k — our procurement team is okay deferring the remainder pending first-month usage.

Let me know when the temporary PO is available and I'll re-submit the onboarding portal request.

Best,
Sara
attachments: evergreen_lineitems.csv

---

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: david.kim@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:03:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evergreen onboarding: missing PO & spend cap block

Team — quick status update. I just issued a provisional PO stub so Evergreen can proceed while we finalize numbering and SOW: PO_2026-00078 (provisional). Stub attached.

What I did:
- Created provisional PO (PO_2026-00078) in the procurement queue with staged spendcap $25,000 for first 30 days.
- Flagged Finance Ops to review for escalation to $50k on day 21 based on usage and billing cadence.
- Left a note for billing to split professional services to a separate invoice line per the CSV mapping.
- Opened JIRA PROC-4821 for the permanent PO trace and requested the ledger owner to remap any merchant-level line items that require splitting.

Attachments: PO_2026-00078-stub.pdf

Marcus — please confirm the SKU→GL mapping and whether any line items need to be split across ledgers. Once you confirm, I'll push the permanent PO request.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
